requirements.scope: Selected subscription and environment resource group
requirements.rationale: Preprovision inspects the selected resource group and creates it if azd has not yet done so, before creating the environment-bound Key Vault.

requirements.scope: Environment resource group and deterministic Key Vault name
requirements.rationale: Preprovision creates or verifies the exact vault and grants the selected operator only secret get/set access through a vault access policy during initial bootstrap.

requirements.scope: Exact Teams connection in the selected environment resource group
requirements.rationale: The optional read-only deployment validator reads the existing connection status. It does not authorize, modify, or send through the connection and does not assign this permission.

requirements.resource: Selected alert and lifecycle Logic Apps
requirements.scope: Exact alert and lifecycle workflows in the selected environment resource group
requirements.rationale: The optional read-only deployment validator uses typed exact-resource endpoint construction to read latest run metadata and the safe Compose_expiration action. That action is treated only as requested-expiration evidence and never as authoritative Graph subscription freshness. The validator avoids subscription-create outputs and does not start, change, or delete a workflow or Graph subscription.

gaps: The schema has no Key Vault access-policy kind. The selected operator also needs secret get/set data-plane access; no workflow managed identity receives Key Vault access.
Existing Microsoft Graph app roles, delegated administrator consent, Teams connector consent, and Azure cleanup permissions are documented separately but not yet fully inventoried in this manifest.

The optional validator adds no Graph permission and performs no permission grant. It rejects malformed environment selectors before token acquisition and allows only the exact configured connection, workflow latest-run, and Compose_expiration ARM GET endpoints. Subscription freshness always remains explicitly unknown because the safe lifecycle action proves only a requested expiration, not Graph's accepted/current state; recipient receipt still requires external confirmation.
